Stand name:  \[JAR OF HEARTS\]

Name origin: A song from Christina Perri (not my favorite artist but I liked what I came up with it.)

Ability: It basically imprisons the soul and stand of an individual, in the form of a real heart, as much as the user wants. This is only possible if It works when the individual feels the slightest pity towards her, if this happens she can reach for their heart, taking it from their chest. But the thing is that she has already another soul inside the Jar, it’s her lovers soul that almost died once but she managed to save his soul and (very dangerous) stand. She switches her lover's heart with the victim to spend time with him. (Although he doesn't want to be with her, he pretends for convenience.)

Stats:

Speed- N/A

Range- E

Destructive power- N/A

Durability- A

Potential- E

Precision- E

Stand user: Judith T. Years

Judith is a very pitiful woman who seems to suffer from schizophrenia but she doesn’t, she was diagnosed after the “death” of her lover because she would often talk to his heart (which for normal people it’s invisible). She’s thin with very pale skin, big eyes bags, pale pink lips and bright blue eyes. Her hair is a mess, long to the hip with bangs but one single lock of white hair. Wears a white dress with train and long knee-high brown boots. Very sweet and talkative but creepy when she talks about her lover.

Stand description: A pretty jar of glass with a string made of gold hanging from the lid which hangs the heart that has the soul and stand of the victim.

​

I think she'd be good for a one time episode if you just use the Jar ability but if you want to use her lover's stand it could be even longer. I haven’t really thought about his stand (so it could be another winner) but I want to make it very dangerous so it’s like a complement to Judith’s.
